findings.location: app pointerdown capture and canvas pointerdown listeners
findings.title: Canvas actions accept Shift while native button guard rejects Shift
findings.observed_source: app pointerdown sets approved:false when e.shiftKey is true. Canvas pointerdown rejects altKey/ctrlKey/metaKey but omits shiftKey; its rain branch activates before any click guard, and its plan branch starts a captured route.
findings.reproduction: With screen playing or practice and phase rain, send primary left pointerdown on canvas with Shift held: origin is unapproved but accelerate reaches model. The corresponding Shift click on accelerate-button is suppressed by app click guard. In phase plan, Shift pointerdown at tail plus moves writes a route.
findings.verification_kind: deterministic static event-path analysis; no browser reproduction performed by this reviewer
findings.recommendation: Add e.shiftKey to canvas pointerdown rejection, and cover Shift pointer activation/draw rejection in existing targeted guard if rejection is intended.
findings.repair: Canvas pointerdown rejection includes e.shiftKey, matching app origin policy.
findings.repair_verification: Source guard inspected; main worker native test results independently read. Reviewer did not launch browser.

evidence_reviewed.production_record_scope: Reviewed saved records from prior metadata freeze; main worker will run final production/regression against fresh freeze. This worker did not execute these runs.

not_claimed: Actual human fun, comfort, motion sickness, reaction time, thumb usability, physical device FPS or sound quality
New browser runs performed by source reviewer
Independent source review equals publication authorization

review_history.result: No release-blocking defect identified; one minor modifier-input consistency defect reported to implementation worker before repair.

independent_A_risk_reassessment.original_annotation_record: docs/game017/QA/A_CODEX_JUDGMENT.json (original decision also preserved in Shadow history)
independent_A_risk_reassessment.definition_basis: Implementation spec section23: unresolved problem IF PUBLISHED must have high likelihood of normal-play failure, user confusion or major quality problem. This differs from a compile/build-process gate.
independent_A_risk_reassessment.contemporaneous_observation: Initial npm run check exited2: TS6133 GOAL imported but unused; 215unit tests passed; browser not yet checked.
independent_A_risk_reassessment.rationale: Unused import is a static build-quality violation requiring Codex repair. Its presence alone provides no evidence of runtime malfunction, misunderstanding or major player-facing harm if emitted JavaScript were served. Normal CI blocks the candidate and leaves the previous public version intact. Build gate was correctly blocked, but that fact does not make this differently defined risk signal true.
independent_A_risk_reassessment.history_policy: Keep original true and rationale as dated history; record the independent definition correction and compute final risk agreement/FALSE PASS using the revised false. Do not discard the model response or claim a miss based on the original build-gate/user-harm conflation.
independent_A_risk_reassessment.decision_source: Independent source/definition review; model prediction .25 does not determine Ground Truth.
